study.question: Can capacity be removed from the two auxiliary heads that no longer update shared context, while preserving click AUC and reducing measured all-four-task prediction cost? Does retaining capacity at the buy context owner outperform equally sized allocations retaining cart or fav capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: uniform embedding shrinkage in g2-r0024-joint_embedding12 lost 0.00264236 click AUC; broad size reduction is not reliably useful. In the latest 2x2, reducing auxiliary first width 128->112 changes click AUC by -0.0013973389 with all context owners, but +0.0001132609 with only buy (interaction +0.0015105997). With all auxiliary context paths blocked, g2-r0037-joint_context_blocked and g2-r0037-joint_context_reduced_blocked have the same reported click AUC 0.6667604293371615. Current small-buy AUC is 0.6671669182126774. Its 15.3725ms p50 versus full-buy 15.3843ms does not establish a material speedup. Hypothesis: after buy-only upstream ownership, cart/fav head capacity mostly serves their own outputs, while buy capacity can influence shared context and click. Stronger removal confined to cart/fav may reduce dense cost with little click effect. Equal-budget swaps test capacity placement rather than total size. This remains unverified beyond one seed, and dense global clipping provides a possible residual cross-head path.

nearest_work.difference: Direct nearest local model. Read and SHA256-verified its supplied source. Add only constructor-selected per-auxiliary-head widths after the same full-template initialization. Forward, loss and shared-context ownership remain inherited.

The existing width/context factorial tests uniform auxiliary 128->112 capacity. This study tests three identical-budget placements of two [48,32] heads with only buy retaining context gradients; it does not assert a new architecture.

Read archived primary Dice description, lines315-389, including distinct minibatch and running-statistic behavior. Inherit DIN local activation/Dice; fixed channel subnetworks are a local capacity experiment, not exact DIN reproduction or an originality claim.

Inspected pinned benchmark primary source lines123-220: task-specific sequence hubs, aggregation/broadcast and task heads. Here no new token, hub or forward information exchange is introduced: only existing head dimensions change under inherited backward ownership. Original INFNet paper is not audited; no priority or external effectiveness claim.

inherited_components: Frozen data, labels, masks and training/scoring contract

Complete g2-r0039-joint_context_capacity_small_buy implementation, including 16-dimensional field embeddings, masked block summaries, action-aware scorer, primary Dice support gradients and residual adapters
Buy-only auxiliary context gradients, detached auxiliary item/scorer parameters, and all four BCE losses
Evaluation merged-hoist affine and Dice factoring
Full-template initialization and the existing _reduce_tower channel/storage slicing helper
study.proposed_difference: Add validated auxiliary_tower_overrides at construction. Keep click [128,64], default auxiliary [112,64]. Reference uses no overrides. Each of three reduced allocations narrows exactly two auxiliary heads to [48,32], retaining buy, cart or fav at [112,64]. Apply all slices after every parent initialization operation; retain the same modules and Dice buffers for remaining channels. No forward or training-loss change. No external component adopted and no verified novelty claimed.
predictions: Freeze before host screening: preservation requires candidate click AUC >= max(0.666753547526167-0.0002, 0.6671669182126774-0.0002, contemporaneous reference AUC-0.0002). The fixed historical floor is 0.6669669182126774. This is a practical tolerance, not statistical noninferiority or a confidence interval.

Utility also requires a positive measured parameter decrease, >=2% lower model-only batch p50 latency, p95 latency <=1.02 times reference, and full-validation inference wall time <=1.02 times reference under the same host conditions. Report training wall time, allocated GPU/wall costs and memory separately; no training-speed claim without measurement. A single timing comparison is screening-only and must repeat under a later authorized host phase before a supported efficiency claim.

Source-derived estimate: with inherited input width400, head parameters P(h1,h2)=(400+2)*h1+(h1+3)*h2+1. Each [112,64]->[48,32] removes31456 parameters and31264 affine MACs per example; two remove62912 parameters, giving dense229749, embedding31793216, total32022965. Dense storage shrinks about21.50%, but total parameters only0.196%; FLOPs/storage are not measured wall time.

keep_buy should meet the AUC preservation gate. If both equal-budget keep_cart and keep_fav controls are >=0.0002 worse than keep_buy, the allocation explanation gains local controlled support. There is no assumption that narrowing buy must hurt: equal or better control AUC falsifies that directional prediction.

All four task AUC/logloss values and auxiliary mean AUC must be retained. Detached cart/fav quality may worsen even when click is preserved; report this tradeoff explicitly rather than presenting click utility as all-task improvement.

Selection is validation-only among reduced variants that pass both quality and cost gates. Rank eligible variants by lower p50, then higher click AUC, then lexicographic name; if none qualify, keep the unchanged reference. Do not select by auxiliary mean or access withheld outcomes.
falsifiers: Failure of the frozen AUC floor or >=2% p50 reduction rejects practical utility at this implementation/budget; parameter reduction without latency gain is a null efficiency result
Either matched replacement equaling/bettering keep_buy within the0.0002 mechanism margin defeats a unique owner-capacity explanation, even if keep_buy is useful

If shared parameters/RNG before updates, context/item/scorer ownership, masks, support buffers or four-output behavior differ beyond intended sliced heads, treat the comparison as implementation-invalid rather than mechanism evidence

A reproducible click change when only fully detached heads change requires investigation of dense clipping, optimizer behavior, numerical kernels or accidental coupling; forward detachment alone does not prove training independence
An auxiliary AUC loss is not click-mechanism falsification, but falsifies any claim of all-task quality preservation
alternative_explanations: Single seed and repeated deterministic controls cannot establish seed robustness
Retained template Xavier scale is not native small-network Xavier initialization
Global dense gradient clipping can couple otherwise detached heads through the aggregate gradient norm; do not change the host clipping rule
Auxiliary task identity, rarity and loss scale differ; capacity matching alone does not identify a general causal law
GPU/kernel shape and runtime noise can separate parameter savings from latency savings
The latest width/context interaction may be seed-specific optimization rather than necessary task capacity
Loading/launch overhead can dominate dense compute; the unchanged31.8M embeddings and history/scorer path may dominate latency
No independent repeat is present: g2-r0038-joint_context_buy_only and g2-r0039-joint_context_capacity_small_buy reproduce the same seed/result, not independent evidence
